summary: Tested Vendor Price Comparison Dashboard feature (GET /api/vendor-comparison/normalized endpoint and /vendor-comparison frontend page). All 15 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI fully functional with all features working correctly.

backend_api_tests.test_response_structure: PASS - Response has comparisons and stats keys with correct structure
backend_api_tests.test_qualifying_items_have_valid_normali: PASS - All items have normalized_price_per_lb > 0 and LB/OZ units
backend_api_tests.test_no_excluded_units_in_results: PASS - No EA, GAL, PK or other non-weight units in results
backend_api_tests.test_multi_vendor_items_sorted_first: PASS - Multi-vendor items appear before single-vendor items
backend_api_tests.test_comparison_group_structure: PASS - All groups have required fields (item_key, comparison_unit=LB, entries, best_price, spread_pct, vendor_count, is_multi_vendor)
backend_api_tests.test_entry_structure: PASS - All entries have required fields (vendor, raw_name, pack_size_raw, unit_price, total_case_weight, pack_unit, normalized_price_per_lb, invoice_date)
backend_api_tests.test_best_price_is_minimum: PASS - best_price is correctly the minimum in each group
backend_api_tests.test_entries_sorted_by_price_ascending: PASS - Entries within groups sorted by price ascending
backend_api_tests.test_stats_counts_match_data: PASS - Stats counts match actual data (12 items, 6 groups, 5 multi-vendor, 3 vendors)
backend_api_tests.test_exact_match_grouping: PASS - Item grouping is exact-match (conservative, no fuzzy merge)
backend_api_tests.test_expected_items_present: PASS - Found expected items (CHICKEN BREAST BNLS, FLOUR ALL PURPOSE, etc.)
backend_api_tests.test_excluded_items_not_present: PASS - Excluded items (LETTUCE ROMAINE HEARTS, CONTAINER FOAM 150CT) not in results
backend_api_tests.test_expected_vendors_present: PASS - Found 3 expected vendors (US Foods Test, Sysco Restaurant Supply, Performance Food Group)

frontend_ui_tests.stat_cards: PASS - All 4 stat cards display correctly (12 Qualifying Items, 6 Item Groups, 5 Multi-Vendor Items, 3 Vendors Represented)
frontend_ui_tests.info_banner: PASS - Info banner visible explaining comparison methodology
frontend_ui_tests.comparison_groups: PASS - 6 comparison groups displayed with expandable details
frontend_ui_tests.best_badge: PASS - BEST badge appears on cheapest entry in multi-vendor groups
frontend_ui_tests.table_columns: PASS - All required columns present (Vendor, Raw Item Name, Pack Size, Case Price, Case Weight, $/LB, Invoice Date)
frontend_ui_tests.multi_vendor_filter: PASS - Shows 5 groups when Multi-Vendor filter selected
frontend_ui_tests.single_vendor_filter: PASS - Shows 1 group when Single Vendor filter selected
frontend_ui_tests.all_items_filter: PASS - Shows 6 groups when All Items filter selected
frontend_ui_tests.search_by_item: PASS - Search for 'chicken' shows 1 group (CHICKEN BREAST BNLS)
frontend_ui_tests.sidebar_nav_link: PASS - 'Vendor $/LB' link present in sidebar and navigates correctly to /vendor-comparison
frontend_ui_tests.nav_link_active_state: PASS - Nav link is highlighted when on vendor comparison page

features_verified: 1. GET /api/vendor-comparison/normalized returns only qualifying items (normalized_price_per_lb > 0, pack_unit in LB/OZ)
2. Response excludes items with failed/not_applicable status or non-weight units (EA, GAL, PK)
3. Multi-vendor items appear first in results, sorted by spread_pct descending
4. Item grouping is exact-match (conservative, no fuzzy merge)
5. Stats object contains correct counts (total_qualifying_items=12, total_groups=6, multi_vendor_groups=5, vendors_represented=3)
6. Frontend /vendor-comparison page renders stat cards, info banner, comparison groups
7. Each comparison group shows vendor, raw_name, pack_size_raw, case price, case weight, $/LB, invoice date
8. BEST badge appears on cheapest entry in multi-vendor groups
9. Search filter works for item and vendor names
10. Multi-Vendor / Single Vendor filter buttons work correctly
11. Sidebar nav link 'Vendor $/LB' is present and navigates correctly
critical_code_review_comments: Backend endpoint correctly filters by NORMALIZABLE_UNITS (LB, OZ only)
Conservative item grouping uses exact-match after uppercase normalization
Stats calculation is accurate and matches actual data
Frontend correctly displays all required columns and badges
Filter and search functionality working as expected
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded data: US Foods Test, Sysco Restaurant Supply, Performance Food Group purchases with overlapping items
